Derive requirements from architecture, resources, boundaries, failure modes,
recovery, security, incidents, and deployment. Do not infer them only from
existing tests. Read the inherited profile list from the boundary manifest; do
not repeat it here.

```text

**Classification:**
**Trigger:**
**Category:**
**Boundary:**
**Targets:**
**Acceptance criteria:**
**Required evidence level:**
**Rationale:**
```
